mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition, defined as unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for 3 consecutive months, signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 1 month signals deteriorating economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by at least 0.5% over 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 260) indicate strong consumer demand and low interest rate sensitivity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises and CPIAUCSL remains below 260.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 255.0 for 3 consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) triggers a shift to risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0 and FEDFUNDS is above 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market volatility, which increases uncertainty about economic growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE increases by at least 0.1 percentage points.
